Eine zum UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe zählende Ruinenstätte, die einst die zeremonielle Hauptstadt des Achämenidenreichs war.
UNESCO világörökségi romterület, amely egykor az Akhaimenida Birodalom ceremoniális fővárosa volt.
Un sit arheologic din patrimoniul mondial UNESCO, care a fost odată capitala ceremonială a Imperiului Ahemenid.
A UNESCO World Heritage ruin site that once served as the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire.

Történelem előtti régészeti ásatási helyszín Perszepolisz közelében, amely festett kerámiáiról ismert.

A prehistoric archaeological excavation site near Persepolis renowned for its painted pottery.

An ancient excavation area located in the immediate vicinity of the historical Persepolis complex.

Un lăcaș de cult islamic local situat nu departe de ruinele istorice ale Persepolisului.
A local Islamic place of worship situated not far from the historical ruins of Persepolis.

The Haj Maktabi Mosque is a traditional Islamic place of worship integrated into the vibrant cultural streetscape of Shiraz.

landmark
